answer_1.quote: Graph-to-text (G2T) generation and text-to-graph (T2G) triple extraction are two mutually inverse tasks... G2T verbalizes the structural information in KG with descriptive texts... T2G aims to extract triples from text...
answer_1.outputs: descriptive texts and linearized graph sequences

answer_2.quote: For G2T, we adopt several widely used automatic metrics, i.e., BLEU, Meteor, and CIDEr... For T2G, we use the micro F1 score to evaluate the quality of the generated triples.
